text:
Nadia: FYI new-model bringup (qint8-proto) shows a focused regression on prompts containing inline CSV/table-grid blobs. BLEU-like down ~0.06 vs fp32 on promptbank/tables.

Tom: drop eval command + a couple failing ids? I can repro locally.

Nadia: repro:
```
rwt eval --model newmodel-qbringup --dataset promptbank/tables-holdout --metrics bleu,exact_match --batch 64 --tokenizer grid-split-v2
```
sample deltas: id: tbl-043 delta_bleu -0.27 tokens 198, id: tbl-190 delta_bleu -0.14 tokens 34

Ibrahim: tagging curation + label ops. Could be anchor-provenance shift after the last soft-dedupe sweep. We lowered fuzzy threshold to 0.72 earlier.

Sasha: infra note: no driver/kernel changes. ci-bot: eval job eval-19821 started: https://ci.internal/evals/19821

Tom: quick per-prompt check shows many failures where tokenizer splits commas vs pipes differently. Also some duplicates in top-100 appear to be orphan anchors.

labeler-bot: Rapid queue: 3 labelers, 150 items. ETA for top-100 triage: ~9h.

Ibrahim: plan:
1) run eval with tokenizer pinned to grid-split-v1 (previous),
2) run micro soft-dedupe on top-200 (fuzzy 0.78) and flag orphan anchors,
3) surface top-100 to labelers with rubric: token-boundary, table-parsing, hallucination, deid.

Nadia: agree. Assign workspace "rapid-table-triage" and include the CSV/blob handling notes. Hold canary until confirmation.

Tom: variant runs: tokenizer v1 restores most cases (bleu 0.435 -> baseline 0.447). With qint8-proto the remaining gap concentrates on long table-csvs.

labeler-bot: Update: 3 labelers processed 60/100: flags so far: 20 tokenization, 7 formatting, 5 deid, 6 duplicates.

Ibrahim: I'll run micro-golden refresh for flagged anchors and push a dedupe backfill. Sasha — can you spare a shared node for 3h rescore?

Sasha: reserving a dev node starting in 20m. ci-bot: micro-gold job mg-442 queued.

Tom: preparing a small CI test to assert tokenizer parity between baseline and qbringup; adding per-prompt delta logging. PR incoming.

Nadia: decision: block rollout until labeler verdicts + micro-gold rescore. If labels show >25% formatting/token issues we can relax soft-dedupe threshold back to 0.8.

Ibrahim: noted. Posting spreadsheet with top-100 and instructions: https://docs.internal/rapid-table-triage

labeler-bot: Final quick update (end of shift): 100/100 processed. Totals: 27 tokenization, 10 formatting, 6 deid, 12 dupes, 45 model regressions.

Nadia: thanks. We'll rerun full eval after micro-gold rescore + land tokenizer parity PR. Reopen thread with final numbers.
